title: TCL 43C645 (reports as "Smart TV Pro"), Android TV 11 (SDK 30), Realtek RTD2851 / R51MT05,
header:
TCL 43C645 (reports as "Smart TV Pro"), Android TV 11 (SDK 30), Realtek RTD2851 / R51MT05,
firmware V8-R51MT05-LF1V652, Google TV launcher (com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx).
List derived from examples/tcl-65c725 (same Android 11 TCL platform), checked against this unit's packages.

Tested 2026-10-19 on a real unit, applied in three batches with a screenshot after each: Ethernet stayed up,
Home and the D-pad, the launcher's Sources menu (HDMI via TvInputManager), Netflix, and Home from Netflix all
worked, also after a reboot. Private DNS (AdGuard) kept working. Quirks: the stock launcher is
com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx and setupwraith takes HOME as soon as it is disabled; tools/b64push.py
failed its md5 check here, plain `adb push` + `pm install -r` worked.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-43c645/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-43c645/debloat.txt
Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx. HOME fallback com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith
takes over once it is disabled, so it is disabled too (group 1b). Home then resolves to the new launcher.
Kept by choice: voice (com.tcl.assistant, katniss), Cast receiver (mediashell), Live TV (com.tcl.tv).
Never disable: com.tcl.providers.config com.tcl.initsetup com.tcl.factory.view com.tcl.system.server
com.tcl.tcl_bt_rcu_service com.tcl.autopair com.tcl.tvinput com.tcl.tv com.tcl.tvpassthrough com.tcl.settings
com.tcl.inputmethod.international com.tcl.sourcemananger com.tcl.keycustomfunctionservice

sections.title: 1b
sections.note: Google TV first-run wizard (claims HOME once the stock launcher is off)
